plugins.name: sun
plugins.description: /sunrise bootstraps a new project across every layer and proves it live; /sunset archives one reversibly.

plugins.name: clerk
plugins.description: Clerk: a portable read-only auditor that surveys any files, repos, or notes and returns a prioritized cleanup punch list, changing nothing.

plugins.name: det-audit
plugins.description: /det-audit scans a session or a repo for recurring LLM work that could become deterministic code, returning a ranked PURE SCRIPT / JIG / KEEP LLM punch list. Report-only.
